shortDescription: The USP Banner Studio section displays unique selling propositions in a narrow horizontal strip, typically placed below the header. On mobile devices, navigation arrows allow users to scroll through multiple USPs. Merchants can configure each item with a title and icon (defaulting to checkmark), then apply style presets or custom colors to match their branding. Ideal for highlighting shipping benefits, return policies, or competitive advantages.
